name: india_search_acts
description: Find Indian acts by title words in the Legislative Department's India Code repository. Central acts by default; set jurisdiction to a state name for state acts. Returns act_id, year, act number, ministry, enactment and in-force dates, and a repealed flag. Note the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 replaced the Indian Penal Code from 2024-07-01.

jurisdiction.description: CENTRAL (default) or a state name such as "Maharashtra"

name: india_get_section
description: Fetch the text of one section of an Indian act from India Code. Pass the act title (or act_id) and the section number, e.g. act "Indian Contract Act, 1872", section "73". For the repealed Indian Penal Code (e.g. "Section 302 IPC") it returns the current Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita successor section (IPC 302 -> BNS 103) with the text, clearly marked as the successor, for a curated list of well-known offences.

act.description: Act title ("Indian Contract Act, 1872"), "Indian Penal Code"/"IPC", or an act_id from india_search_acts

name: india_search_sections
description: Search section headings across Indian acts by words, e.g. "murder" finds BNS s.103 "Punishment for murder". Optionally restrict to one act via act_id. Returns section number, heading and a text preview; use india_get_section for full text.

query.description: Words in the section heading or text

act_id.description: Restrict to one act (act_id from india_search_acts)

name: india_search_provisions
description: Full-text search over the text of about 1.1 million provisions of Indian central and state legislation and of fifteen regulators (RBI, SEBI, MCA, IRDAI, TRAI, CBIC and others). Finds the sections that discuss a subject, e.g. "anticipatory bail", "limitation period for suits", "data fiduciary consent". Returns the act, section, a text excerpt and rank; optionally limited to one jurisdiction (central, a state name, regulations) or one act_id. Source: Open India Law (Vaquill AI), CC BY 4.0.

query.description: Words to find in provision text, e.g. "anticipatory bail"

jurisdiction.description: "central", a state or union territory (e.g. "Tamil Nadu"), "states" (all state acts), a regulator (e.g. "rbi", "sebi"), or "regulations" (all regulators)

act_id.description: Restrict to one act or instrument (act_id from an earlier result)

name: india_get_provision
description: Fetch the full text of one section of an Indian act or regulator instrument by act title and section number, from the Open India Law dataset (Vaquill AI, CC BY 4.0), e.g. act "Information Technology Act, 2000" section "43A". Returns the section text with its sub-sections, the act's status and source link; a missing section returns the sections the act does have.

act.description: Act title ("Indian Contract Act, 1872") or an act_id from india_search_provisions

jurisdiction.description: Optional: "central", a state name, a regulator, "states" or "regulations" to disambiguate similar titles

name: india_search_judgments
description: Full-text search over the TEXT of Indian court judgments: the Supreme Court of India and 25 High Courts, about 32.6 million passages of judgment text (1950 onward). Finds the judgments that discuss a subject or quote a phrase, e.g. "adverse possession limitation", "anticipatory bail economic offences", "doctrine of basic structure". Returns one result per judgment: case title, court, decision date, citation, case number, CNR, disposal, an excerpt around the matched words and a ref for india_get_judgment. Filter by court (e.g. "delhi", "bombay", "supreme-court") and by year or from_year/to_year. Source: Open India Law (Vaquill AI), CC BY 4.0.

query.description: Words to find in the judgment text, e.g. "adverse possession limitation"

court.description: Optional: "supreme-court" or a High Court by name or slug, e.g. "delhi", "Bombay", "punjab-and-haryana", "kerala"

name: india_get_judgment
description: Fetch the stored text of one Indian court judgment found by india_search_judgments, by its ref (e.g. "delhi:2019:123456"). Returns the case title, court, date, citation, CNR and the judgment text with the passage overlaps removed; long judgments are returned from start_chunk in pieces of max_chars (default 20000) with next_start_chunk to continue. Source: Open India Law (Vaquill AI), CC BY 4.0.

start_chunk.description: Continue from this passage number (next_start_chunk of the previous call); default 0
